title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 3,901–3,950 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

examples.en: Conscious consumers support sustainable fashion brands that practice fair trade.
examples.zh: 具備環保意識的綠色消費者積極支持落實公平貿易與綠色低碳生產的永續時尚品牌。

examples.en: Using renewable resources is essential for building a truly sustainable future.
examples.zh: 使用可再生資源對於建立一個真正永續的未來至關重要。

examples.en: The company introduced sustainable packaging made from plant-based materials.
examples.zh: 該公司推出了採用植物性原料製成的環保永續包裝。

examples.en: Taiwan is a global innovation leader in producing high-tech eco textiles.
examples.zh: 台灣在研發製造高端機能性環保紡織面料與涼感吸濕排汗布料領域居全球領導地位。

examples.en: The museum displayed exquisite antique textiles from the eighteenth century.
examples.zh: 該博物館展出了來自十八世紀的精緻古董紡織品面料。

examples.en: Advancements in textile engineering have created fabrics that actively repel stains.
examples.zh: 紡織工程技術的進步研發出了能夠主動防潑水且抗污漬的新型布料。

words.definition: 有機棉（無農藥天然種植）

examples.en: Baby onesies made from certified organic cotton protect delicate newborn skin.
examples.zh: 採用國際認證無毒有機棉精心縫製的嬰兒連身包屁衣，能溫柔呵護新生兒嬌嫩敏感的肌膚。

examples.en: Farming organic cotton uses significantly less water and eliminates toxic synthetic pesticides.
examples.zh: 種植有機棉能大幅減少農業耗水量，並且完全杜絕使用有害合成農藥。

examples.en: These soft organic cotton bedsheets provide breathable comfort throughout the hot summer.
examples.zh: 這套柔軟親膚的純有機棉床單在炎熱夏季能帶來極佳的透氣舒爽感。

words.definition: 亞麻布料；亞麻亞麻織物

examples.en: Breathable linen button-up shirts keep you cool in Taiwan's humid summer.
examples.zh: 透氣排汗的純天然亞麻短袖開襟襯衫，是炎炎夏日對抗台灣悶熱潮濕氣候的最佳消暑穿搭。

examples.en: Natural linen develops soft, elegant creases that add relaxed character to your outfit.
examples.zh: 天然亞麻在穿著時會產生自然的微皺褶，為整體造型增添隨性俐落的質感。

examples.en: She chose crisp white linen curtains to let soft natural light illuminate the living room.
examples.zh: 她選用了素雅潔白的純亞麻窗簾，讓柔和的自然光灑落進客廳各個角落。

examples.en: A Mulberry silk pillowcase reduces hair friction and prevents morning frizz.
examples.zh: 睡在頂級百分之百純桑蠶絲真絲枕套上能大幅減少頭髮摩擦，避免晨起秀髮毛躁打結。

examples.en: The bride walked down the aisle in a flowing dress woven from pure ivory silk.
examples.zh: 新娘身著一襲由純象牙白真絲織成的飄逸婚紗緩步走過紅毯通道。

examples.en: Gently hand-wash delicate silk scarves in cold water with mild shampoo.
examples.zh: 清洗細緻昂貴的真絲絲巾時，請務必使用溫和洗髮精或中性冷水輕柔手洗。

examples.en: Ultra-fine Merino wool thermals provide lightweight, odor-resistant mountain warmth.
examples.zh: 超細極致柔軟的美麗諾羊毛（Merino Wool）排汗保暖底衫能為高山百岳登山提供無負擔溫暖。

examples.en: Natural wool retains body heat effectively even when damp from mountain mist.
examples.zh: 天然羊毛即使在被高山晨霧浸濕的情況下，依然能發揮卓越的鎖溫保暖效果。

examples.en: He wrapped up in a heavy wool overcoat before heading out into the winter blizzard.
examples.zh: 在踏入冬日風雪之前，他裹緊了身上厚實保暖的羊毛長版大衣。

words.definition: 喀什米爾羊絨；頂級羊毛衫

examples.en: A luxurious cashmere sweater feels incredibly plush and featherlight on skin.
examples.zh: 一件經典優雅的頂級喀什米爾純羊絨毛衣觸感無比軟糯親膚，穿在身上如羽毛般輕盈溫暖。

examples.en: Harvested from the fine undercoat of mountain goats, cashmere offers supreme thermal insulation.
examples.zh: 採集自高山絨山羊貼身細緻絨毛的喀什米爾羊絨，具有無與倫比的絕佳保暖性。

examples.en: Store your folded cashmere knits with cedar blocks to protect them from hungry fabric moths.
examples.zh: 收納折疊好的喀什米爾羊絨衫時放幾顆雪松木塊，能有效防止衣蛾啃咬蛀蝕。

examples.en: Heavyweight Japanese raw selvedge denim molds to your body shape over time.
examples.zh: 厚磅數的日本赤耳原色未脫漿丹寧牛仔褲隨著歲月穿著洗禮，會養出獨一無二的專屬色落。

examples.en: Vintage washed denim pairs effortlessly with crisp white tees and work boots.
examples.zh: 復古水洗丹寧牛仔褲隨性搭配一件簡約白 T 恤與工裝靴就帥氣十足。

examples.en: Indigo denim jackets have remained an enduring American casual classic for generations.
examples.zh: 經典的靛藍丹寧牛仔夾克歷經數個世代洗禮，依然是美式休閒風永恆不敗的經典。

words.definition: 合成的人造纖維；綜合的

examples.en: Modern athletic wear blends elastic spandex with lightweight synthetic polyester.
examples.zh: 現代高機能運動服飾巧妙將高彈力彈性纖維與輕量快乾人造合成聚酯纖維黃金混紡。

examples.en: Some synthetic fabrics can trap body heat and perspiration during humid weather.
examples.zh: 某些人造合成面料在悶熱潮濕的天氣下容易悶住身體熱氣與汗水。

examples.en: Technological breakthroughs in synthetic textiles have created remarkable water-repellent shells.
examples.zh: 合成纖維紡織技術的重大突破，研發出了防風防潑水性能卓越的戶外硬殼機能面料。

words.definition: 回收再生的；環保再製的

examples.en: The eco backpack is crafted entirely from recycled PET plastic water bottles.
examples.zh: 這款時尚實用的環保機能後背包完全是由回收廢棄寶特瓶（rPET）抽絲紡織重製而成。

examples.en: Many outdoor clothing brands now produce performance fleeces from recycled nylon nets.
examples.zh: 許多頂尖戶外運動品牌如今廣泛採用海洋廢棄漁網回收再製的再生尼龍刷毛衣。

examples.en: Purchasing items made from recycled materials supports the global transition toward zero waste.
examples.zh: 購買採用回收再生原料製成的產品，能實質支持全球向零廢棄經濟邁進的轉型。

words.definition: 舊衣升級改造；升級再造

examples.en: Creative designers use denim upcycling to transform discarded jeans into trendy patchwork totes.
examples.zh: 充滿巧思的設計師運用舊衣升級改造工法，將淘汰的舊牛仔褲化為極富潮流感的拼接托特包。

examples.en: Upcycling breathes new life into unwanted textiles without requiring extensive chemical reprocessing.
examples.zh: 舊物升級改造無需耗費繁複的化學重製程序，就能為廢棄布料注入嶄新的生命。

examples.en: She won a sustainable design contest by showcasing upcycling techniques on vintage garments.
examples.zh: 她在永續設計大賽中大放異彩，憑藉為二手老舊古著進行升級改造的精湛手法奪冠。

examples.en: High-quality tailored garments last for decades when cared for properly.
examples.zh: 剪裁作工精良的高品質成衣服裝只要平日悉心保養洗滌，穿上數十年依然挺括如新。

examples.en: Each garment undergoes strict quality inspection to check for loose seams and misaligned buttons.
examples.zh: 每一件出廠的成衣服飾都要經過嚴格品檢，仔細檢查是否有脫線或鈕扣縫偏的瑕疵。

examples.en: Read the care label inside the garment carefully before using hot water or bleach.
examples.zh: 在使用熱水清洗或漂白水之前，請務必先仔細閱讀服裝內側的水洗標籤說明。

examples.en: Circular fashion designs clothes with biodegradable fabrics for cradle-to-cradle recycling.
examples.zh: 循環時尚從搖籃到搖籃的設計思維出發，採用百分之百天然可降解面料以實現完全閉環循環。

examples.en: Moving toward a circular economy reduces reliance on virgin resources and eliminates waste.
examples.zh: 走向循環經濟模式能大幅降低對原生原物料資源的過度依賴並減少固體垃圾。

examples.en: The brand launched a circular take-back program that repairs or recycles worn-out jackets.
examples.zh: 該品牌推出了循環舊衣回收方案，負責修補破損舊衣或將其拆解再製成新商品。

words.definition: 復古經典古著的；老式名品；年份酒

examples.en: Fashion students hunt for authentic 1990s vintage leather jackets in Chifeng Street.
examples.zh: 潮流青年與設計系學生最愛在台北赤峰街文青巷弄中淘選貨真價實的九零年代經典古著皮衣。

examples.en: Vintage clothing offers unique character and craftsmanship rarely found in mass-produced items.
examples.zh: 古著服飾具備獨特的時代韻味與手工溫度，這是現代大量生產的成衣所無法比擬的。

examples.en: She accessorized her contemporary dress with a rare vintage brooch passed down from her grandmother.
examples.zh: 她在現代洋裝上別了一枚祖母流傳下來的珍稀復古古董胸針，作為整體視覺點睛之筆。

words.definition: 二手選物；節儉；古著店 (Thrift Store)

examples.en: Thrifting pre-loved designer clothes saves money while reducing landfill textile waste.
examples.zh: 逛二手古著選物店挑選保存良好的名牌美衣既省荷包，更能從源頭大幅減少廢棄舊衣垃圾。

examples.en: You can uncover hidden treasures at local thrift shops if you have the patience to browse.
examples.zh: 只要你有足夠的耐心一架一架翻找，在當地的二手古著店經常能淘到驚喜寶藏。

examples.en: Thrift culture encourages consumers to value secondhand fashion and embrace individual style.
examples.zh: 二手選物文化鼓勵現代消費者重視二手衣物的價值，並勇敢擁抱屬於自己的獨特風格。

examples.en: Sell your gently worn luxury handbags through trusted consignment boutiques.
examples.zh: 將家中保存完好、極少使用的二手名牌精品包送至有商譽的二手寄賣專門店進行估價託銷。

examples.en: The consignment shop authenticates high-end designer pieces before placing them on sale.
examples.zh: 專業二手寄賣精品店在商品上架開賣之前，皆會安排專業鑑定師驗明正身。

examples.en: Consignment models allow buyers to acquire luxury goods at a fraction of their retail prices.
examples.zh: 二手寄售模式讓精品愛好者得以用遠低於專櫃零售價的優惠價格入手奢華名品。

examples.en: Building a minimalist capsule wardrobe eliminates morning outfit decision fatigue.
examples.zh: 打造實穿百搭的極簡「膠囊衣櫥」（Capsule Wardrobe），能徹底告別清晨出門前的選衣焦慮。

examples.en: Clean out your wardrobe each spring to donate garments you have not worn in the past year.
examples.zh: 每年春季趁機整頓斷捨離衣櫥，將過去一年從未穿出門的閒置衣物捐贈給慈善機構。

examples.en: A well-curated wardrobe contains versatile essentials that can be mixed and matched endlessly.
examples.zh: 一個精心規劃的實用衣櫥應包含多種百搭核心基本款，能輕鬆交替混搭出無數造型。

words.definition: 極簡主義的；極簡風格者

examples.en: The Japanese minimalist aesthetic focuses on clean lines and neutral earth tones.
examples.zh: 日系極簡美學強調俐落純粹的幾何線條、舒服寬鬆的剪裁以及溫潤百搭的無印大地色調。

examples.en: As a dedicated minimalist, he owns only thirty clothing items that suit every occasion.
examples.zh: 作為一名堅定的極簡主義實踐者，他全身上下的衣物僅有三十件，卻能應付各種場合。

examples.en: Minimalist interior design creates a serene, clutter-free environment that promotes mental clarity.
examples.zh: 極簡主義的居家室內設計營造出靜謐清爽、遠離雜亂的空間氛圍，有助於沉澱心靈。

examples.en: A crisp white button-down shirt is the most versatile staple in any closet.
examples.zh: 一件挺拔合身的經典白襯衫是任何男女衣櫥中進可攻、退可守最不可或缺的百搭神級單品。

examples.en: This versatile trench coat can be styled with formal workwear or casual weekend jeans.
examples.zh: 這款百搭的英倫長版風衣既能搭配正式上班西裝，也能隨性混搭週末牛仔休閒褲。

examples.en: Choosing versatile pieces maximizes the number of outfits you can assemble with fewer garments.
examples.zh: 挑選多功能的百搭單品能用最少數量的衣服，組合搭配出最多變豐富的穿搭風格。

examples.en: Influencers post stylish daily #OOTD (outfit of the day) photos on Instagram.
examples.zh: 潮流穿搭網紅每日在 Instagram 上打卡分享充滿巧思與層次感的精緻 #OOTD 今日穿搭照片。

examples.en: She completed her chic outfit with a pair of leather ankle boots and gold hoop earrings.
examples.zh: 她穿上一雙俐落真皮短踝靴並戴上金屬圈型耳環，讓整套時髦穿搭更加畫龍點睛。

examples.en: Selecting an appropriate outfit for a job interview creates an outstanding first impression.
examples.zh: 為求職面試挑選得體合宜的正式套裝穿搭，能為考官留下極佳的第一印象。

examples.en: Winter layering combines a merino base, cashmere knit, and heavy wool overcoat.
examples.zh: 冬季洋蔥式多層次穿搭將美麗諾排汗打底衫、喀什米爾針織毛衣與長版羊毛大衣完美融合。

examples.en: Mastering layering allows you to adapt seamlessly between cold outdoor winds and heated rooms.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握多層次穿搭心法，能讓你在戶外刺骨寒風與室內暖氣房之間自如穿脫應對。

examples.en: Visual layering using differing textures and hemlines adds depth to simple outfits.
examples.zh: 運用異材質面料與不同長短下擺營造視覺上的多層次感，能為單調衣著注入豐富層次。

words.definition: 服裝剪裁輪廓；外觀線條

examples.en: Oversized boxy silhouettes provide an effortless, relaxed streetwear aesthetic.
examples.zh: 落肩寬鬆的箱型服裝剪裁輪廓能營造出一種隨性不羈、率性自在的現代街頭潮流氛圍。

examples.en: The A-line silhouette of the vintage dress flatters a wide range of body types.
examples.zh: 這件復古洋裝的經典 A 字型剪裁輪廓，對於修飾各種不同體型皆非常友善。

examples.en: High-waisted trousers create a sleek, elongated silhouette that accentuates your waistline.
examples.zh: 高腰剪裁的打褶長褲能勾勒出挺拔修長的下半身輪廓，凸顯纖細腰線線條。

words.definition: 量身訂製的；精細剪裁的

examples.en: A perfectly tailored blazer instantly elevates casual jeans into smart-casual chic.
examples.zh: 一件版型線條極致挺拔的合身剪裁西裝外套，能瞬間將隨性牛仔褲升級為俐落的商務休閒風。

examples.en: Wearing a tailored suit to the international conference gave him a polished, authoritative look.
examples.zh: 穿著一套量身精細訂製的西裝出席國際研討會，賦予了他俐落專業且具權威感的氣場。

examples.en: The skirt features a tailored waistband that contours closely without feeling restrictive.
examples.zh: 這款半身裙擁有立體量身收腰設計，能貼合腰部線條且完全不產生勒肉壓迫感。

words.definition: 經典永恆的；永不過時的

examples.en: Invest in timeless quality over transient fast-fashion micro-trends.
examples.zh: 與其盲目追逐轉瞬即逝的快時尚微趨勢，不如將預算投資在歷久彌新、永不過時的傳世經典。

examples.en: A classic leather jacket possessing timeless appeal never goes out of fashion.
examples.zh: 具備歷久彌新永恆魅力的經典騎士真皮夾克，無論時代如何更迭都絕不退流行。

examples.en: Audrey Hepburn's little black dress remains one of cinema's most timeless fashion moments.
examples.zh: 奧黛麗赫本所穿的經典小黑洋裝，至今依然是世界影壇中最具永恆標誌性的時尚高光時刻。

examples.en: The double-breasted beige trench coat shields against chilly autumn breezes in style.
examples.zh: 經典雙排扣卡其色英倫風長版風衣既能優雅抵擋秋日微涼陣風，更展現落落大方的俐落氣場。

examples.en: Originally designed for military officers in rainy trenches, the trench coat is now an urban fashion staple.
examples.zh: 經典風衣最早源於軍官在多雨泥濘戰壕中的防雨軍服，如今已成為都市穿搭的不可或缺單品。

examples.en: Cinch the waist belt tightly to create an elegant hourglass silhouette with your trench coat.
examples.zh: 將風衣腰帶隨性扣緊打結，能立即勒出優雅迷人的沙漏型腰身比例與俐落線條。

words.definition: 休閒西裝外套；便服西裝

examples.en: Pair an unstructured navy blazer with white sneakers for Friday office meetings.
examples.zh: 在輕鬆的週五便服日，以深藍色軟呢休閒西裝外套混搭簡約小白鞋，展現得體幹練。

examples.en: She tossed an oversized tweed blazer over her shoulders for an effortlessly chic look.
examples.zh: 她將一件微墊肩落肩粗花呢西裝外套隨意披在肩頭，營造出漫不經心的時髦優雅。

examples.en: A black tailored blazer can transition smoothly from daytime business meetings to evening cocktails.
examples.zh: 一件黑色合身剪裁休閒西裝外套，能無縫切換白天的商務會議與晚間的餐敘酒會。

words.definition: 開襟針織羊毛衫；針織外套

examples.en: Keep a cozy knit cardigan on your office chair to combat freezing air conditioning.
examples.zh: 在辦公室椅背上常備一件柔軟親膚的開襟針織小外套，隨時應對室內超強冷氣房低溫。

examples.en: He buttoned up his chunky wool cardigan and sat by the crackling fireplace.
examples.zh: 他扣好身上厚實粗棒針開襟羊毛衫的鈕扣，悠閒地坐在噼啪作響的壁爐旁取暖。

examples.en: A cropped pastel cardigan adds a sweet, feminine touch when paired with high-waisted denim.
examples.zh: 短版馬卡龍粉彩色開襟針織衫搭配高腰牛仔褲，能為整體休閒穿搭增添甜美溫柔氣質。

words.definition: 連帽衛衣 (帽 T)；連帽衫

examples.en: A heavyweight fleece-lined hoodie is the ultimate comfort wear for weekend lounging.
examples.zh: 內裡加絨加厚的厚磅連帽衛衣（帽 T）是週末在家放鬆追劇或下樓買咖啡最舒適的慵懶單品。

examples.en: He pulled the drawstring on his oversized gray hoodie to block out the chilly morning wind.
examples.zh: 他拉緊寬鬆灰色帽 T 上的抽繩，抵擋清晨迎面吹來的刺骨冷風。

examples.en: Layering a denim jacket over a hooded sweatshirt creates a timeless casual street look.
examples.zh: 在連帽衛衣外面疊穿一件刷色丹寧牛仔夾克，是經典永恆、充滿青春氣息的街頭風格。

examples.en: A slim black turtleneck layered beneath an overcoat exudes Parisian sophistication.
examples.zh: 在長版毛呢大衣內搭一件合身顯瘦的黑色高領打底衫，舉手投足間散發法式優雅知性美。

examples.en: Roll the collar of your wool turtleneck down neatly to frame your jawline.
examples.zh: 將羊毛高領毛衣的領口工整向下折疊翻捲，能漂亮修飾俐落的下顎線條。

examples.en: Wearing a merino turtleneck keeps your neck warm without needing an extra scarf outdoors.
examples.zh: 在戶外穿著一件美麗諾高領打底衫能為頸部鎖住溫暖，省去了額外圍圍巾的麻煩。

words.definition: 寬版及膝裙褲；闊腿寬褲

examples.en: High-waisted flowing culottes elongate legs while allowing effortless movement.
examples.zh: 高腰垂墜感極佳的西裝及踝闊腿寬褲能在視覺上極致拉長腿部比例，且走起路來步履生風。

examples.en: Linen culottes are a comfortable, airy choice for sweltering summer city walks.
examples.zh: 純亞麻材質的七分闊腿褲在酷熱盛夏的城市漫步中，是無比清涼透氣且舒適的穿搭首選。

examples.en: She paired pleated culottes with pointed-toe heels for a modern, architectural silhouette.
examples.zh: 她以打褶闊腿裙褲搭配一雙俐落尖頭細高跟鞋，勾勒出極具現代建築感的俐落立體廓形。

words.definition: 丹寧吊帶褲；工作連身褲

examples.en: Vintage denim overalls paired with striped tees create a playful, retro vibe.
examples.zh: 刷色復古經典的丹寧牛仔吊帶褲內搭一件法式條紋 T 恤，營造出俏皮活潑的減齡復古感。

examples.en: The mechanic slipped into a pair of durable cotton overalls before servicing the car engine.
examples.zh: 汽車維修技師在動手檢修汽車引擎之前，穿上了耐磨防油污的厚棉連身工作服。

examples.en: Roll up the cuffs of baggy overalls to show off colorful socks and retro skate shoes.
examples.zh: 將寬鬆吊帶褲的褲管隨意往上翻折兩折，剛好露出一截亮眼跳色短襪與復古滑板鞋。

examples.en: Minimalist white leather sneakers match effortlessly with both suits and floral dresses.
examples.zh: 極簡全白真皮休閒小白鞋是無敵百搭鞋款，無論搭配俐落西裝抑或碎花洋裝皆毫無違和。

examples.en: Cushioning insoles in modern sneakers protect your knees and feet during long journeys.
examples.zh: 現代休閒球鞋內置的緩震氣墊鞋墊，能為長途跋涉旅遊提供極佳的足弓支撐與膝蓋減震保護。

examples.en: Clean your favorite canvas sneakers with a soft toothbrush and baking soda paste.
examples.zh: 使用軟毛舊牙刷沾取小蘇打糊，能溫和且高效刷洗掉心愛帆布球鞋上的頑固污垢。

examples.en: Classic leather horsebit loafers add an air of polished refinement to work attire.
examples.zh: 經典馬銜扣黑色真皮樂福鞋能為日常通勤辦公穿搭增添一抹精緻講究的學院英倫紳士風範。

examples.en: Suede penny loafers slip on effortlessly without the hassle of tying shoe laces.
examples.zh: 絨面麂皮便士樂福鞋穿脫極為輕鬆隨性，完全省去了反覆彎腰繫綁鞋帶的瑣碎麻煩。

examples.en: Pair dark brown loafers with tailored cropped trousers for an elegant collegiate Ivy look.
examples.zh: 以深棕色樂福鞋搭配九分打褶西裝長褲，能完美演繹優雅雋永的美式常春藤學院風。

words.definition: 雀爾喜靴；鬆緊側帶短踝靴

examples.en: Elastic-sided Chelsea boots slip on easily and resist rainy winter puddles.
examples.zh: 兩側附有高彈性織帶的真皮雀爾喜短靴穿脫極為便捷，雨天出門踩水也能常保帥氣乾爽。

examples.en: Black leather Chelsea boots are versatile footwear that complements slim-fit jeans and wool suits alike.
examples.zh: 黑色真皮雀爾喜靴是極度百搭的必備鞋款，無論是搭合身牛仔褲還是毛呢西裝都極為合適。

examples.en: The pull-tab at the heel helps you slide smoothly into your Chelsea boots in seconds.
examples.zh: 靴筒後側貼心設計的提鞋拉耳，能讓你在短短數秒內輕鬆順滑地穿進雀爾喜靴中。

examples.en: A bold turquoise necklace served as the vibrant statement piece of her outfit.
examples.zh: 一條造型誇張大膽的綠松石復古鎖骨鏈成為她整套素雅黑色洋裝中最奪目吸睛的視覺焦點。

examples.en: Wearing statement earrings instantly draws attention to your face and brightens simple tops.
examples.zh: 戴上一副造型搶眼的焦點大耳環能瞬間將視覺重心引向臉龐，點亮素色上衣。

examples.en: The fashion house issued a public statement clarifying its new cruelty-free material standards.
examples.zh: 這家知名時尚奢侈品牌發表了一份公開聲明，闡明其全面採用零殘忍環保面料的新規範。

examples.en: Wrap a soft tartan wool scarf snugly around your neck on chilly mornings.
examples.zh: 在寒流來襲的微冷清晨，將一條柔軟溫暖的經典英倫蘇格蘭格紋羊毛圍巾輕柔環繞於頸間。

examples.en: Tying a vibrant silk scarf onto the handle of a tote bag adds a pop of personality.
examples.zh: 將一條色彩明艷的印花真絲絲巾隨意繫在托特包提把上，能立即為包款增添獨特個人品味。

examples.en: An oversized blanket scarf can double as a warm wrap during long flights in chilly cabins.
examples.zh: 寬大厚實的披肩式毛毯圍巾，在搭乘長途客機寒冷的機艙內能隨時化身為保暖小蓋毯。

examples.en: A durable organic cotton canvas tote holds laptops, books, and grocery goods.
examples.zh: 厚實耐磨的純棉帆布大托特包容量超大，能輕鬆裝入十五吋筆電、書籍與超市採買小物。

examples.en: Many bookstores give away printed canvas totes to promote literacy and reduce single-use bags.
examples.zh: 許多獨立文青書店會贈送印有文宣字樣的帆布托特包，以提倡閱讀並減少一次性塑膠袋。

examples.en: A structured leather tote bag is the quintessential work bag for modern professionals on the move.
examples.zh: 一款外觀俐落立體的真皮公事托特包，是現代職場商務人士通勤奔波時最無懈可擊的百搭包款。

examples.en: Compact leather crossbody bags keep your hands free during lively night market strolls.
examples.zh: 輕巧隨身的小巧真皮斜背包能解放雙手，讓您在熱鬧的台灣觀光夜市逛街吃小吃毫無負擔。

examples.en: Adjust the wide strap of your crossbody bag so the pouch sits comfortably on your hip.
examples.zh: 調節好斜背包的寬版減壓背帶長度，讓包身恰到好處、舒適地貼靠在骨盆髖部兩側。

examples.en: A lightweight nylon crossbody bag is an ideal companion for safeguarding passports while traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 一款防潑水且超輕量的尼龍斜背包，是出國旅遊時貼身保管護照與重要證件的最佳神隊友。

examples.en: Delicate sterling silver jewelry adds a subtle sparkle without feeling gaudy.
examples.zh: 精緻小巧的 925 純銀極簡鎖骨鏈與小耳環能為整體造型點綴低調奢華的微光，絕不落俗套。

examples.en: She keeps her heirlooms and delicate gold jewelry neatly organized in a velvet jewelry box.
examples.zh: 她將祖傳傳家首飾與細緻純金項鍊分門別類、井然有序地收納在絲絨珠寶盒中。

examples.en: Artisanal handcrafted jewelry often features recycled metals and ethically mined gemstones.
examples.zh: 獨立手作職人金工珠寶飾品往往大量採用再生貴金屬與符合人道採礦標準的天然寶石。

examples.en: Traditional aboriginal artisans sew exquisite beadwork and vibrant geometric embroidery.
examples.zh: 台灣原住民族工藝大師以精巧雙手在一針一線中縫製出華美絢麗的圖騰琉璃珠與立體幾何刺繡。

examples.en: Intricate floral embroidery adorned the collar and cuffs of the silk bridal blouse.
examples.zh: 細緻繁複的立體繁花刺繡優雅裝飾在絲綢新娘襯衫的衣領與袖口處，盡顯工藝之美。

examples.en: She picked up thread embroidery as a mindful hobby to unwind after stressful workdays.
examples.zh: 她在下班後將傳統針線刺繡作為療癒身心的手作嗜好，藉此在緊繃的生活節奏中徹底放鬆。

examples.en: Inspect double-reinforced stitching along jeans pocket corners for long-lasting durability.
examples.zh: 挑選牛仔褲時請仔細檢查褲袋邊角的雙道加固縫線車工，以確保耐磨耐穿、長久不脫線。

examples.en: Contrast yellow stitching along the welt is an iconic hallmark of Dr. Martens boots.
examples.zh: 鞋底沿條邊緣標誌性的亮黃色對比車縫線，是馬汀大夫靴最深入人心的經典招牌標記。

examples.en: Precise machine stitching guarantees that the leather seams will not unravel under heavy tension.
examples.zh: 針腳細密均勻的精密機械車縫工藝，能確保整塊真皮拼接接縫在長期拉扯下絕不脫線崩裂。

examples.en: Take long suit trousers to a master seamstress for professional hem alteration.
examples.zh: 將褲長過長的全新西裝長褲送至專業老經驗修改師傅手中，進行精準量身的褲腳修改。

examples.en: Minor waist alterations can transform an off-the-rack dress into a bespoke-fitting masterpiece.
examples.zh: 只要針對腰圍進行微幅細緻的修改，就能讓成衣架上的量產洋裝展現如高級訂製服般的合身體態。

examples.en: The bridal salon offers complimentary seam alterations before the final wedding gown fitting.
examples.zh: 這家婚紗禮服專門店在婚禮前最後一次試穿驗收前，提供免費貼心的修改縫線服務。

examples.en: The neighborhood seamstress expertly replaced the broken coat zipper in minutes.
examples.zh: 巷口修改衣服的資深裁縫阿姨手腳俐落，三兩下功夫便為羽絨外套換上了全新的 YKK 拉鍊。

examples.en: An experienced seamstress pinned the fabric along the waist to measure an exact taper.
examples.zh: 經驗豐富的女裁縫師俐落地沿著腰線別上大頭針定位，以量出分毫不差的收腰比例。

examples.en: Her mother worked as a talented seamstress in a high-fashion atelier for over thirty years.
examples.zh: 她的母親曾在一間高級女裝高級訂製工坊擔任資深裁縫師，默默耕耘長達三十餘年。

examples.en: Delicate silk shirts and heavy wool overcoats require professional dry cleaning.
examples.zh: 細緻的天然真絲襯衫與厚重純羊毛大衣必須交由信譽良好的專業洗衣店進行溫和乾洗。

examples.en: She dropped off her husband's wool business suits for dry cleaning on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 她在週一清晨上班前，將丈夫平時開會穿的羊毛西裝外套打包送去專業洗衣店乾洗。

examples.en: Certain petroleum-based solvents used in traditional dry cleaning are being replaced by eco-friendly alternatives.
examples.zh: 傳統乾洗過程中使用的某些石油系溶劑，目前正逐步被更天然無毒的環保洗滌劑所取代。

words.definition: 手持式掛燙機；蒸鍋；汽船

examples.en: A handheld garment steamer quickly smooths out stubborn wrinkles from linen shirts.
examples.zh: 隨手拿起輕巧的手持式蒸氣掛燙機，數秒內即可撫平亞麻襯衫上頑固惱人的皺褶。

examples.en: Travel steamers are compact enough to pack into carry-on luggage for business trips.
examples.zh: 便攜折疊式旅行掛燙機體積十分輕盈小巧，能輕鬆收納進登機箱中伴隨商務出差同行。

examples.en: Unlike traditional flat irons, a vertical steamer relaxes fabric fibers without crushing their texture.
examples.zh: 與傳統重磅熨斗不同，直立式蒸氣掛燙機藉由高溫蒸氣舒展纖維，絕不會壓扁織物原有蓬鬆紋理。

examples.en: Use eco-friendly, enzyme-based laundry detergent that washes cleanly in cold water.
examples.zh: 挑選含有天然生物酵素、能在冷水中徹底洗淨汗漬且不破壞環境的環保中性洗衣精。

examples.en: Pour a small cup of hypoallergenic liquid detergent into the washing machine dispenser.
examples.zh: 將一小量杯低敏無香精的液態天然洗衣精緩緩倒入滾筒洗衣機的洗劑專用分配槽中。

examples.en: Concentrated laundry detergent requires only a small capful to clean an entire load of clothes.
examples.zh: 高濃縮洗衣精配方只需倒半個瓶蓋的微小劑量，就能將整槽滿滿的髒衣物洗得乾乾淨淨。

examples.en: Mindful fashion enthusiasts prioritize exceptional fabric quality over sheer cheap quantity.
examples.zh: 懂穿搭的品味人士始終堅持「質量重於數量」（Quality Over Quantity），買少買好。

examples.en: Reducing the quantity of fast-fashion purchases frees up budget for enduring staple pieces.
examples.zh: 大幅減少購買廉價快時尚衣服的數量，能騰出更多充裕預算投資在經久耐穿的傳世單品。

examples.en: Warehouses track the exact quantity of incoming fabric bolts before factory manufacturing starts.
examples.zh: 服裝倉儲物流中心在服裝工廠正式裁片開工前，會嚴密清點到庫布匹的精確批次與數量。

examples.en: Getting dressed each morning is a wonderful form of creative self-expression.
examples.zh: 每天早晨站在鏡子前用心搭配衣服，是一種向世界無聲傳遞個人獨特美學的自我性格展現。

examples.en: Personal style is an authentic expression of one's unique identity, mood, and creativity.
examples.zh: 個人穿搭風格正是每個人內在獨特身份認同、當日心情以及無限創造力最真實的表達。

examples.en: Her relaxed facial expression reflected a deep sense of confidence in her chosen outfit.
examples.zh: 她臉龐上流露出的從容優雅表情，全然反映出對自己今日這身穿搭所散發的由衷自信。

examples.en: She developed a distinct quiet luxury aesthetic featuring understated cashmere coats.
examples.zh: 她逐漸摸索並確立了個人標誌性的「靜奢風」（Quiet Luxury）低調美學，偏好剪裁上乘的素色大衣。

examples.en: Scandinavian design is renowned for its clean aesthetic that harmonizes form and function.
examples.zh: 北歐斯堪地那維亞設計以純淨洗練的美學聞名於世，完美兼顧了優雅造型與實用機能。

examples.en: Changing your shoe choice can completely shift the overall aesthetic of your outfit.
examples.zh: 僅僅換穿一雙不同風格的鞋履，就能徹底逆轉整套日常穿搭所散發出的整體視覺風格美學。

examples.en: Wearing clothes that fit comfortably makes you radiate calm, confident energy.
examples.zh: 穿著剪裁合身舒服、真正契合個人身型的衣服，能讓您在任何場合皆散發出沉穩自信的光芒。

examples.en: She felt completely confident walking into the presentation in her sharp navy suit.
examples.zh: 身著一襲剪裁銳利的深藍色西裝套裝踏入演講簡報會場，讓她內心感到篤定且充滿自信。

examples.en: A genuine warm smile is the most powerful accessory for a truly confident appearance.
examples.zh: 一抹發自內心真誠溫暖的自信微笑，是任何華麗裝扮中最能展現從容大器氣場的無敵配件。
